attempts.summary: Configured persistent `opsbot` accounts and ED25519 key-based SSH access from node1 to node2. Password and keyboard-interactive SSH authentication are disabled for `opsbot` on both systems. Both nodes restarted sequentially and recovered with changed boot IDs, healthy SSH services, preserved keys, and successful node1-to-node2 command execution. Ubuntu 24.04.3 and kernel 6.8.0-71 were retained.
